description: This Java source file defines the class GrantRevokeIndex, which provides an index to manage granted and revoked permission mappings for a policy resource. It contains methods for creating, copying, mutating, and querying permission sets related to authorization subjects.

classes.name: GrantRevokeIndex
classes.description: A class that maintains indices of granted and revoked permissions for subjects, providing mechanisms for creation, mutation, and permission checks.

methods.name: GrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Default constructor initializing empty grant and revoke maps.

methods.name: GrantRevokeIndex
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with specific grant and revoke maps, ensuring none are null.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the map of granted permissions to subjects.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the map of revoked permissions from subjects.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current index with the weights of all permission-subject pairs decremented by one.

methods.name: overrideBy
methods.description: Mutates this index based on another index, updating grant and revoke mappings accordingly.

methods.name: hasPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the given subjects have all specified permissions granted without revocation, considering weights.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns involved subject IDs for the given permissions, deprecated in favor of getEffectedSubjects.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjects
methods.description: Returns subjects for who all or some permissions are granted or revoked.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves subject IDs granted specific permissions.

methods.name: getGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves AuthorizationSubject objects granted specific permissions.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjectIds
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves subject IDs revoked specific permissions.

methods.name: getRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves AuthorizationSubject objects revoked specific permissions.
